DETAIL PAGE INTRO
You start with a public booking page for customers and a private dashboard for your team. Customers book as guests in five short steps, and you manage services, staff hours and every booking in one place. It suits any business where people book time with a named person, such as a salon, clinic, studio or consultancy.

DETAIL SECTIONS
## What you get
A home page with a Book now button and your live list of services, each with its length and price. A booking page in five steps: service, staff, date, time and details, with a month calendar that shows which days have free times. A confirmation page with a booking reference. Behind a sign-in, a dashboard with today's schedule, what is coming up and bookings per day, plus pages for bookings, services, staff, customers and settings.

## Who it is for
A salon, barber or beauty studio where customers choose who they see. A clinic, therapist or coach offering sessions of a set length. A consultant or tutor with a small team taking appointments. It fits less well if you run classes or events where many people book the same time slot, or if customers need to pay when they book, since neither is included.

## Making it yours
Most people first fill in Settings with their company name, logo, welcome text and time zone, then add their own services and team. After that, typical requests in chat are "add a short break between appointments", "send a reminder email the day before", "let customers cancel from their confirmation email" or "add a page about the business". You can also change colours and wording by editing visually.

HIGHLIGHTS
Five-step booking for guests, no account needed
Calendar that only offers times that are free
Dashboard with today's schedule and charts
Staff with their own services and weekly hours

CAPABILITIES
Confirmation page and confirmation email with a booking reference
The same staff member can never be booked twice for the same time
Bookings list with search, filters by status, staff and service, and cancel
Customer records built from bookings, with each person's booking history
Admin sign-in with password reset by email, in light and dark themes

NOTES
- Title: no input given. The app calls itself "RiverX Booking" (package.json, README, default VITE_APP_NAME), but that is a placeholder brand name, so I used the descriptive "Appointment Booking App". Change it if you want a named title such as "Booking Studio".
- Preview image and live preview URL: not in the inputs or the repo, so left empty (null in JSON). No preview was opened or compared with the code.
- Confirmation email: the booking flow always tries to send it, but it only goes out once an email sender is configured on the server (RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM). Without them it is only logged and the confirmation page says to keep the reference. Check this on the hosted preview before claiming it in the copy.
- Privacy: README and DATABASE.md warn that the RiverX preview's browser key ships in the preview's bundle, and the preview shares the published app's database, so anyone who gets that key can read customer names, emails and phone numbers. Published apps don't ship the key; admin data goes through the app's own admin-only `/api/db`. The copy does not mention this.
- There is no sample data: a new project shows an empty "no services yet" state until an admin adds services and staff. The copy says "add your own services" rather than "swap the sample services".
- Only one automated email exists (booking confirmation) plus the password-reset email. Cancelling a booking does not email the customer; customers cannot cancel or reschedule themselves; payments, reminders, buffers and time off are not included. The "Making it yours" examples are requests to add these, not existing features.
- Inviting more admins needs a server setting (ADMIN_SIGNUP_CODE), so it is left out of the capabilities.
- Close to limits: description 147/160, capability "Bookings list with search, filters by status, staff and service, and cancel" 75/80, capability "Customer records built from bookings, with each person's booking history" 72/80.
